criteria_verification.notes: Test test_transcript_frame_precedes_tokens PASSED in independent verification. Frame ordering correctly enforced: transcript frame emitted immediately after transcription, before turn_stream_fn yields token frames.

Three validation refusal tests PASSED: oversized, empty, and unsupported format recordings all yield error TurnEvents with correct error_type, never raised as exceptions. Non-terminal behavior confirmed.

Boundary tests PASSED: recording exactly at size cap accepted and proceeds to transcription; one byte over refused with RecordingTooLarge error. Identical error_type to plain voice_turn, channel remains usable.
Test test_actual_bytes_judged_not_declared PASSED. Implementation validates audio_bytes parameter directly (actual received bytes), not any declared size from headers.

Test test_speech_services_down_non_terminal PASSED. VoiceUnavailable exceptions from AudioClient.transcribe caught and yielded as error events with error_type='VoiceUnavailable', not raised. Non-terminal confirmed.

Seam test test_ws_voice_turn_calls_shared_validation_core PASSED. Implementation uses patch to verify validate_audio_bytes from validation.py is invoked. No duplicate validator - shared VOX-004 core confirmed.
